title: Sinonimlar orasidagi nozik farqlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida sinonimlarni ma’no, uslub, hamrohlik va ohang bo‘yicha farqlay olasiz, kontekstga mos aniq so‘zni tanlaysiz va o‘quvchi lug‘atidan to‘g‘ri foydalanasiz.

scenes.title: Sinonimlarning nozik farqlari
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda akademik so‘zlarni oilalari, hamrohlari va rasmiy sinonimlari bilan o‘rgandik. Bugun keyingi qadam: sinonim deb o‘ylagan so‘zlar orasidagi nozik farqni ajratamiz. Dars oxirida ma’no, uslub, hamrohlik va ohang bo‘yicha to‘g‘ri so‘z tanlay olasiz hamda lug‘atdan o‘zingizga kerakli ma’lumotni topa olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome. Last time we built academic word families. Today we ask a sharper question: when two words seem to mean the same, how do you choose the right one?
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar akademik so‘z oilalarini o‘rgandik. Bugun aniqroq savol: ikki so‘z bir xil ma’noli tuyulsa, to‘g‘risini qanday tanlaymiz?

scenes.title: Aniq sinonim deyarli yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Asosiy fikr: ikki so‘z deyarli hech qachon to‘liq bir xil emas. Ular to‘rt jihatdan farq qilishi mumkin. Birinchi: ma’no, ya’ni qamrov va darajasi. Ikkinchi: uslub, ya’ni so‘z so‘zlashuvda, neytral yoki rasmiy uslubda ishlatiladimi. Uchinchi: hamrohlik, qaysi so‘zlar bilan keladi. To‘rtinchi: ohang, so‘z maqtaydimi yoki yomonlaydimi. Bugungi dars shu to‘rt jihat bo‘yicha tuzilgan.
scenes.say: Two words are rarely identical. They may differ in meaning, in register, in the words they combine with, and in connotation: whether they praise or criticise.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki so‘z kamdan-kam bir xil bo‘ladi. Ular ma’no, uslub, hamrohlik va ohang jihatidan farq qilishi mumkin: maqtaydimi yoki tanqid qiladimi.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bitta so‘z, inglizcha ko‘plari
board: katta → big · large · great · huge · vast
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilidan kelayotganlar uchun asosiy tuzoq shu: bitta o‘zbekcha so‘z bir nechta inglizcha so‘zga to‘g‘ri keladi, siz esa hammasiga bitta so‘zni qo‘llaysiz. Katta deganda hamma narsa big bo‘lib chiqadi. Chiroyli ayol beautiful yoki pretty, chiroyli erkak handsome. Kuchli strong yoki powerful, tez fast, quick yoki rapid. Har birining o‘z o‘rni bor, endi ularni ajratamiz.
scenes.say: One Uzbek word often covers several English ones. Katta can be big, large, great, huge or vast. Each has its own territory.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta o‘zbekcha so‘z ko‘pincha bir nechta inglizcha so‘zni qoplaydi. Katta big, large, great, huge yoki vast bo‘lishi mumkin. Har birining o‘z hududi bor.

scenes.title: Katta so‘zining oilasi
board: a large number · a large amount
a vast majority · a vast area
a huge success · an enormous task

examples.t: A large number of students applied.

scenes.say_native: Endi katta so‘zini ajratamiz. Large neytral va rasmiy, son va miqdor bilan: a large number, a large amount. Great ahamiyat va daraja bilan: great importance, a great deal. Vast keng hudud yoki ulkan ulush haqida: the vast majority, a vast area. Huge va enormous kuchaytirilgan, hissiyotli: huge success, enormous task. Big eng umumiy, so‘zlashuvga yaqin, “a big number” esa g‘alati eshitiladi.
scenes.say: A large number of students applied. The vast majority agreed. It was a huge success. Large is for amounts, vast for extent, great for importance.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p sonli talaba ariza berdi. Aksariyat rozi bo‘ldi. Bu katta muvaffaqiyat bo‘ldi. Large miqdorga, vast keng qamrovga, great ahamiyatga tegishli.

scenes.title: Kuchli va tez
board: strong tea · strong wind · strong evidence
quick look · quick decision · rapid growth
scenes.say_native: Strong va powerful. Choy, shamol va dalil strong bo‘ladi. Dvigatel, kompyuter va vosita esa powerful. “Strong computer” deyilmaydi. Fast va quick: fast tezlikka ega narsa uchun, fast car, fast food. Quick esa qisqa vaqt oladigan harakat uchun: a quick look, a quick decision. Rapid rasmiyroq va o‘sish, o‘zgarish, taraqqiyot bilan keladi: rapid growth, rapid change.
scenes.say: She made a quick decision. The region saw rapid growth. Strong tea, powerful engine; fast car, quick look.
scenes.say_uz: U tez qaror qabul qildi. Hududda tez o‘sish kuzatildi. Strong tea, powerful engine; fast car, quick look.

scenes.title: Sinonim emas, hamrohlik xatosi
board: ✗ a big number of people · ✓ a large number of people
✗ a strong computer · ✓ a powerful computer
✗ a fast look · ✓ a quick look
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta tipik xato. “A big number of” emas, “a large number of”. “Strong computer” emas, “powerful computer”. “Fast look” emas, “quick look”. “Strong rain” emas, “heavy rain”. Siz o‘zbekcha mantiq bilan so‘zma-so‘z tanlayapsiz: kuchli yomg‘ir, tez qarash. Inglizcha ma’noni emas, juftlikni eslab qoling. Har safar qiyin bo‘lsa, so‘zni hamrohi bilan birga yozing.
scenes.say: A large number of people. A powerful computer. A quick look. Heavy rain. These pairs are fixed, and no rule explains them.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p odam. Kuchli kompyuter. Tez nazar. Kuchli yomg‘ir. Bu juftliklar qat’iy va ularni qoida bilan tushuntirib bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Mos so‘zni tanlang
board: 1) big / large number    2) strong / powerful engine
3) heavy / strong rain    4) quick / fast look
scenes.say_native: Beshta ibora. Qavs ichidagi ikki variantdan to‘g‘risini ayting. Birinchi: big yoki large number. Ikkinchi: strong yoki powerful engine. Uchinchi: heavy yoki strong rain. To‘rtinchi: quick yoki fast look. Beshinchi: vast yoki big majority. Javoblaringizni ketma-ket ayting.
scenes.say: One: a big or large number? Two: a strong or powerful engine? Three: heavy or strong rain? Four: a quick or fast look? Five: a vast or big majority?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: big yoki large number? Ikki: strong yoki powerful engine? Uch: heavy yoki strong rain? To‘rt: quick yoki fast look? Besh: vast yoki big majority?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: large number, powerful engine, heavy rain, quick look, vast majority. Agar uchtasidan ko‘pini topgan bo‘lsangiz, yaxshi. Ko‘pchilikda heavy rain qiyinchilik tug‘diradi, chunki o‘zbekcha “kuchli yomg‘ir” strong bilan bog‘lanadi. Yodingizda tursin: heavy yomg‘irdan tashqari traffic va smoker bilan ham keladi. Bu so‘zlarni daftarga ustun qilib yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Large number. Powerful engine. Heavy rain. Quick look. Vast majority. Heavy also goes with traffic and smoker.
scenes.say_uz: Large number. Powerful engine. Heavy rain. Quick look. Vast majority. Heavy traffic va heavy smoker ham deyiladi.

scenes.title: Uslub zinapoyasi
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi jihat: uslub. Bir fikr uch xil uslubda aytilishi mumkin. Kids so‘zlashuvda, children neytral, offspring esa ilmiy yoki rasmiy. Start neytral, begin biroz rasmiyroq, commence juda rasmiy. Ask neytral, enquire rasmiy, ayniqsa Britaniya inglizchasida, amerikaliklar ko‘proq inquire deydi. Buy va purchase ham shunday. Hamma holatga bitta uslub mos kelmaydi: ish suhbatida kids yoki start-up yoqimsiz eshitilmaydi, lekin ilmiy maqolada kids g‘alati.
scenes.say: Kids, children, offspring: informal, neutral, formal. Start, begin, commence. Ask, enquire. Buy, purchase. The same idea sounds different at each level.
scenes.say_uz: Kids, children, offspring: so‘zlashuv, neytral, rasmiy. Start, begin, commence. Ask, enquire. Buy, purchase. Bir fikr har bir darajada boshqacha eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Uch uslubda bitta fikr

examples.t: Can I ask about the course?
I would like to enquire about the course.

scenes.say_native: Bir xil fikr uch qavatda. “Kids love it” do‘stlar orasida. “Children love it” maktab yoki yangiliklarda. “Offspring respond positively” biologiya maqolasida. Yana bir misol: “Can I ask about the course?” oddiy savol, “I would like to enquire about the course” esa xat yoki telefonda rasmiy murojaat. Odob, maqsad va auditoriyani o‘ylab tanlang.
scenes.say: Kids love it. Children love it. Offspring respond positively. Can I ask about the course? I would like to enquire about the course.
scenes.say_uz: Bolalarga yoqadi. Bolalarga yoqadi. Nasl ijobiy javob beradi. Kurs haqida so‘rasam bo‘ladimi? Kurs haqida ma’lumot so‘ramoqchi edim.

scenes.title: Eng rasmiyni toping
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta uchlik. Har birida eng rasmiy so‘zni ayting. Birinchi: kids, children, offspring. Ikkinchi: start, begin, commence. Uchinchi: ask, enquire, question. To‘rtinchi: buy, get, purchase. Har bir uchlikda o‘ylab ko‘ring: qaysi biri rasmiy xatda yoki hisobotda uchrardi, qaysi biri do‘stlar suhbatida? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Which is the most formal? One: kids, children, offspring. Two: start, begin, commence. Three: ask, enquire, question. Four: buy, get, purchase.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi biri eng rasmiy? Bir: kids, children, offspring. Ikki: start, begin, commence. Uch: ask, enquire, question. To‘rt: buy, get, purchase.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: offspring, commence, enquire, purchase. Lekin eslab qoling: eng rasmiy so‘z har doim eng yaxshi emas. Oddiy xatda “begin” yoki “start” yetarli, “commence” esa shartnoma yoki e’lonlarda yaxshi. Uslubni bilish uchun ko‘proq o‘qish kerak: qaysi so‘z qayerda uchrashini kuzatib boring. Bu bilim lug‘atdan ham ko‘ra tajribadan keladi.
scenes.say: Offspring. Commence. Enquire. Purchase. The most formal word is not always the best; match the word to the situation.
scenes.say_uz: Offspring. Commence. Enquire. Purchase. Eng rasmiy so‘z doim eng yaxshi emas; vaziyatga moslang.

scenes.title: Uchinchi jihat: ohang
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: ohang, ya’ni konnotatsiya. So‘zning lug‘aviy ma’nosi bir xil bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin unga qo‘shilgan baho boshqa. Ingichka degan ma’noni ifodalovchi so‘zlarni oling. Thin neytral. Slim ijobiy: yoqimli ingichka. Slender nafis. Skinny esa salbiy va so‘zlashuv. Kimgadir “You look skinny” desangiz, uni xafa qilishingiz mumkin. “You look slim” esa maqtov. O‘zbek tilida ham “ozg‘in” va “kelishgan” orasida shunday farq bor.
scenes.say: Thin is neutral. Slim sounds positive. Slender is elegant. Skinny is informal and often negative. The dictionary meaning is similar, but the feeling is not.
scenes.say_uz: Thin neytral. Slim ijobiy. Slender nafis. Skinny norasmiy va ko‘pincha salbiy. Lug‘aviy ma’no o‘xshash, lekin his-tuyg‘u boshqa.

scenes.title: Maqtov yoki tanqid

examples.t: She is thrifty and never wastes money.
examples.uz: U tejamkor va pulni isrof qilmaydi.

examples.t: He is stubborn and refuses to listen.

scenes.say_native: Bir xil xulq-atvorni ikki xil baholash mumkin. Pulni ehtiyot qiladigan odam thrifty bo‘lsa maqtov, stingy bo‘lsa tanqid. Qat’iyatli odam determined, o‘jar odam stubborn. Qiziquvchan odam curious, boshqalarning ishiga aralashadigan nosy. Ishonchli confident, lekin dimog‘dor arrogant. Xarakter tasvirlayotganda avval niyatingizni o‘ylang: maqtayapsizmi yoki tanqid qilyapsizmi?
scenes.say: She is thrifty and never wastes money. He is stubborn and refuses to listen. Same behaviour, different attitude.
scenes.say_uz: U tejamkor va pulni isrof qilmaydi. U o‘jar va quloq solmaydi. Xulq bir xil, munosabat boshqa.

scenes.title: Yana uch juftlik

examples.t: The hotel is inexpensive but comfortable.

scenes.say_native: Cheap narx pastligini bildiradi, lekin ko‘pincha sifat past degan ishorani ham beradi. Inexpensive neytral, affordable esa hamyonbop. Famous ijobiy yoki neytral, notorious va infamous esa yomon ish bilan nom chiqargan. Childlike bu bolalarcha soddalik, maqtov, childish esa bolalarcha, ya’ni pishmagan xatti-harakat, tanqid. Historic tarixiy ahamiyatli voqea, historical esa tarixga oid: a historic victory, a historical novel.
scenes.say: The hotel is inexpensive but comfortable. He is a notorious criminal. A historic victory, a historical novel.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona arzon, lekin qulay. U nomi chiqqan jinoyatchi. Tarixiy g‘alaba, tarixiy roman.

scenes.title: Maqtov o‘rniga haqorat
board: ✗ My boss is very cheap. (maqtov niyatida)
scenes.say_native: Bu xatolar odamlarni xafa qiladi. Rahbaringizni tejamkor demoqchi bo‘lib “cheap” desangiz, uni xasis desangiz bo‘ladi, ayniqsa amerikacha. Do‘stingizga “skinny” desangiz, u ozg‘in va nimjon, deb tushunadi. Maqtamoqchi bo‘lsangiz thrifty va slim. Uchinchi xato: tarixiy voqeani “historical day” demang, agar u muhim bo‘lsa, “historic day”. Ohangni bilmaslik tilni bilmaslikdan ham xavfliroq bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: My boss is thrifty, not cheap. You look slim, not skinny. Connotation can turn a compliment into an insult.
scenes.say_uz: Rahbarim tejamkor, xasis emas. Siz kelishgan ko‘rinasiz, ozg‘in emas. Ohang maqtovni haqoratga aylantirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Ijobiy yoki salbiy
scenes.say_native: Oltita so‘z. Har biri ijobiy yoki salbiy ohangdami, ayting. Birinchi: skinny. Ikkinchi: thrifty. Uchinchi: nosy. To‘rtinchi: determined. Beshinchi: childish. Oltinchi: childlike. Har bir javobga bitta sabab qo‘shishga harakat qiling, masalan: skinny salbiy, chunki u ortiqcha ozg‘inlikni bildiradi. Javoblaringizni ketma-ket, shoshilmasdan ayting.
scenes.say: Positive or negative? One: skinny. Two: thrifty. Three: nosy. Four: determined. Five: childish. Six: childlike.
scenes.say_uz: Ijobiy yoki salbiy? Bir: skinny. Ikki: thrifty. Uch: nosy. To‘rt: determined. Besh: childish. Olti: childlike.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Skinny salbiy, thrifty ijobiy, nosy salbiy, determined ijobiy, childish salbiy, childlike ijobiy. Agar childish va childlike ni adashtirgan bo‘lsangiz, qo‘shimchaga qarang: like bu “o‘xshash”, ya’ni bolaga o‘xshash, yoqimli; ish esa nuqson ma’nosini beradi. Bu faqat eslab qolish usuli, qoida emas, lekin ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Skinny negative. Thrifty positive. Nosy negative. Determined positive. Childish negative. Childlike positive.
scenes.say_uz: Skinny salbiy. Thrifty ijobiy. Nosy salbiy. Determined ijobiy. Childish salbiy. Childlike ijobiy.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: tanqidiy urg‘u
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda ikkita muhim nuqta. Birinchi: so‘z urg‘usi. Infamous da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, INfamous, “inFAmous” emas. Notorious da ikkinchida, noTOrious. Historic da ikkinchida, hisTORic. Ikkinchi: kontrastiv urg‘u. Sinonimlarni qarama-qarshi qo‘ysangiz, so‘zni kuchaytirib aytasiz: “I said SLIM, not SKINNY.” Mana shunday urg‘u tinglovchiga farqni aytadi.
scenes.say: Infamous has stress on the first syllable. Notorious and historic on the second. And to contrast two words, stress them: I said slim, not skinny.
scenes.say_uz: Infamous da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Notorious va historic da ikkinchida. Ikki so‘zni qarama-qarshi qo‘ysangiz, ularni urg‘u bilan ajrating: I said slim, not skinny.

scenes.title: Urg‘u bilan ayting
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Avval infamous, notorious, historic: urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni baland qiling. Keyin ikkita kontrastiv gap: I said slim, not skinny. I said childlike, not childish. Kuchaytirilgan so‘zni biroz balandroq va uzunroq ayting, qolgan so‘zlar tekis va yengil bo‘lsin. Ovozingiz gap ichida ko‘tarilib, keyin pasayishini sezing. Ikki marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Infamous. Notorious. Historic. I said slim, not skinny. I said childlike, not childish.
scenes.say_uz: Infamous. Notorious. Historic. Men slim dedim, skinny emas. Men childlike dedim, childish emas.

scenes.title: Urg‘u bo‘yicha javob
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Infamous birinchi bo‘g‘inda, notorious ikkinchida, historic ham ikkinchida. Kontrastiv gaplarda qarama-qarshi qo‘yilgan so‘zlar balandroq aytiladi: SLIM va SKINNY, CHILDlike va CHILDish. Bu usul munozarada juda foydali: bir so‘zni tuzatganingizni ovoz balandligi bilan ko‘rsatasiz. Inglizlar shunday qiladi: “It’s not stubborn, it’s DEtermined.”
scenes.say: Infamous, first. Notorious, second. Historic, second. Stress the contrasting words, and your listener hears the correction.
scenes.say_uz: Infamous birinchida. Notorious ikkinchida. Historic ikkinchida. Qarama-qarshi so‘zlarni urg‘ulang, tinglovchi tuzatishni eshitadi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: aniq so‘z tanlash
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: aniq so‘zni tanlash. Amaliy tekshiruv uchun to‘rtta savol. Birinchi: bu so‘z ma’no jihatidan va hamrohlari bilan mos keladimi? Ikkinchi: uslub matnga mosmi? Uchinchi: ohang to‘g‘rimi, men nima demoqchiman, maqtovmi yoki tanqidmi? To‘rtinchi: grammatik qolip qanday? Chunki sinonimlar ko‘pincha turlicha qolip talab qiladi, bunga hozir misollar keltiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions for every choice: does it fit the meaning and partners, the register, the attitude, and the grammar pattern?
scenes.say_uz: Har bir tanlov uchun to‘rt savol: ma’no va hamrohlar, uslub, munosabat va grammatik qolip mosmi?

scenes.title: Grammatik qolip farqi
board: persuade sb to do · convince sb that / of
allow sb to do · let sb do

examples.uz: Ular bizni barvaqt ketishga qo‘yib yuborishdi.

scenes.say_native: Sinonimlar qolipi farq qiladi. Persuade bilan odamni biror ish qilishga ko‘ndirasiz: persuade me to apply. Convince esa fikrga ishontirish: convince me that it is true. Allow va permit dan keyin to bilan fe’l keladi: allow us to leave. Let dan keyin to‘siz: let us leave. Suggest dan keyin to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri odam va to emas: suggest taking a break yoki suggest that we take a break. “Suggest me to go” xato.
scenes.say: She persuaded me to apply. They let us leave early. He suggested taking a break. Not: suggest me to go.
scenes.say_uz: U meni ariza berishga ko‘ndirdi. Ular bizni barvaqt ketishga qo‘yishdi. U tanaffus qilishni taklif qildi. Suggest me to go deyilmaydi.

scenes.title: Dalil kuchi shkalasi

examples.t: The data demonstrate a clear link.

scenes.say_native: Akademik yozuvda hisobot fe’llari dalil kuchini bildiradi. Suggest eng ehtiyotkor: taxmin qildiradi. Indicate ko‘rsatib turadi, show va demonstrate aniqroq, prove esa eng kuchli. Ko‘p olimlar prove ni kam ishlatadi, chunki ko‘p tadqiqot mutlaq isbot bermaydi. Kichik tajribada “suggests” xavfsiz, kuchli dalilda “demonstrates”. Noto‘g‘ri fe’l ilmiy kuch haqida noto‘g‘ri xabar beradi.
scenes.say: Reporting verbs carry strength. Suggest is cautious; indicate, show and demonstrate are stronger; prove is the strongest, and researchers often avoid it.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobot fe’llari dalil kuchini bildiradi. Suggest ehtiyotkor; indicate, show, demonstrate kuchliroq; prove eng kuchli va olimlar uni ko‘pincha chetlab o‘tadi.

scenes.title: Haddan tashqari kuchli fe’l
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: kichik, bitta tadqiqot natijasi haqida “proves” deyish. Bu juda katta da’vo. Ehtiyotkor fe’l “suggests” yoki “indicates”. Ikkinchisi: odamni biror ishga undashda “convince me to go” deyish. To‘g‘risi “persuade me to go”, yoki “convince me that…”. Rus tilidagi “ubedit” ikkisiga ham mos keladi, shuning uchun ruscha o‘ylaydiganlar bu yerda adashadi.
scenes.say: A small study suggests; it does not prove. And you persuade someone to go, but convince them that something is true.
scenes.say_uz: Kichik tadqiqot taxmin qildiradi, isbotlamaydi. Odamni borishga persuade qilasiz, biror narsa haqiqat ekaniga esa convince qilasiz.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri fe’lni tanlang
board: 1) One small pilot study: suggests / proves?
2) Very strong, repeated evidence: suggests / demonstrates?
3) She ___ me to apply. persuaded / convinced?
4) He ___ me that it was safe. persuaded / convinced?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: bitta kichik pilot tadqiqot, qaysi fe’l mos: suggests yoki proves? Ikkinchi: kuchli, takrorlangan dalil: suggests yoki demonstrates? Uchinchi: she, nuqta, me to apply, persuaded yoki convinced? To‘rtinchi: he, nuqta, me that it was safe, persuaded yoki convinced?
scenes.say: One: a small pilot study suggests or proves? Two: strong, repeated evidence suggests or demonstrates? Three: she persuaded or convinced me to apply? Four: he persuaded or convinced me that it was safe?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: kichik pilot tadqiqot suggests yoki proves? Ikki: kuchli dalil suggests yoki demonstrates? Uch: persuaded yoki convinced me to apply? To‘rt: persuaded yoki convinced me that it was safe?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: suggests. Ikki: demonstrates. Uch: persuaded me to apply, chunki keyin to bilan fe’l keladi. To‘rt: convinced me that it was safe, chunki keyin that gapi keladi. Qoida oson: to bilan harakat bo‘lsa persuade, that bilan fikr bo‘lsa convince. Agar bu qoidani eslab qolsangiz, o‘zbekcha “ishontirmoq” sizni adashtirmaydi.
scenes.say: Suggests. Demonstrates. Persuaded me to apply. Convinced me that it was safe. Action: persuade. Belief: convince.
scenes.say_uz: Suggests. Demonstrates. Persuaded me to apply. Convinced me that it was safe. Harakat: persuade. Ishonch: convince.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tavsiyanoma
board: B: Maybe determined? He never gives up.
B: Leave appearance out. Write: determined, curious, reliable.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Ikki rahbar yangi nomzod uchun tavsiyanoma yozmoqda. Ular sifatlarni diqqat bilan tanlaydi, ularning ohangi haqida bahslashadi. Savollarga javob berish uchun uchta narsani eslab qoling: qaysi so‘z almashtirildi, nima uchun tashqi ko‘rinish tashlab yuborildi va oxirgi uch sifat nima.
scenes.say: Could you describe Daniel for the reference? He's very stubborn. That sounds negative. Perhaps determined? Yes, he never gives up. And he's rather thin? I would leave appearance out. Agreed. I will write: determined, curious and reliable.
scenes.say_uz: Daniel haqida tavsiyanomada nima deymiz? U juda o‘jar. Bu salbiy eshitiladi. Balki qat’iyatli? Ha, u hech qachon taslim bo‘lmaydi. Va u ancha ozg‘in? Tashqi ko‘rinishni tashlab ketaman. Kelishdik. Yozaman: qat’iyatli, qiziquvchan va ishonchli.

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 3) Which three words are in the reference?
scenes.say_native: Uch savol. Birinchi: stubborn o‘rniga qaysi so‘z tanlandi? Ikkinchi: nima uchun tashqi ko‘rinish haqida yozilmadi? Uchinchi: tavsiyanomadagi uchta sifat qaysilar? Suhbatni diqqat bilan eslang va har bir savolga to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Agar kerak bo‘lsa, dialogdagi gaplarni ichingizda qayta ayting.
scenes.say: One: which word replaced stubborn? Two: why leave out his appearance? Three: which three words are in the reference?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: stubborn o‘rniga qaysi so‘z? Ikki: nega tashqi ko‘rinish tashlandi? Uch: tavsiyanomadagi uchta so‘z qaysi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) It is not relevant to the job.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: determined, chunki u salbiy emas, ijobiy ohangda. Ikkinchi: tashqi ko‘rinish ish uchun ahamiyatsiz va noxush taassurot qoldirishi mumkin. Dialogda buni aniq aytilmagan, lekin “leave appearance out” iborasidan tushuniladi. Uchinchi: determined, curious va reliable. Diqqat qiling: tavsiyanomada ohang katta rol o‘ynaydi, chunki bitta sifat qaror qilishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Determined. Appearance is not relevant to the job, so they leave it out. And the final words: determined, curious, reliable.
scenes.say_uz: Determined. Tashqi ko‘rinish ishga aloqasiz, shuning uchun tashlab ketiladi. Yakuniy so‘zlar: determined, curious, reliable.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: lug‘at bilan ishlash
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: lug‘at bilan ishlash. Ikki tilli lug‘at tez, lekin u sinonimlar orasidagi farqni ko‘rsatmaydi: katta, large, big, huge hammasi bir qatorda. Shuning uchun C1 darajada bir tilli o‘quvchilar uchun lug‘atdan foydalaning, masalan Oxford, Cambridge yoki Longman. Ularda ta’rif, misol gaplar, uslub belgilari va hamrohlar bor. Hamrohlik uchun alohida collocations lug‘ati ham bor.
scenes.say: A bilingual dictionary is quick, but it hides differences. A learner's dictionary gives definitions, example sentences, register labels and typical partners.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki tilli lug‘at tez, lekin farqlarni yashiradi. O‘quvchilar uchun mo‘ljallangan bir tilli lug‘at ta’rif, misol, uslub belgisi va hamrohlarni beradi.

scenes.title: Lug‘at maqolasini o‘qish
board: = determined not to change your opinion
a stubborn refusal · stubborn as a mule
He is stubborn and never listens.
scenes.say_native: Bitta lug‘at maqolasini o‘qiymiz. Avval so‘z turkumi: sifat. Keyin belgi: disapproving, ya’ni salbiy ohang. Keyin ta’rif: fikrini o‘zgartirmaslikka qaror qilgan. Keyin hamrohlar: stubborn refusal. Va nihoyat misol gap. Yangi so‘zni ishlatishdan oldin hech bo‘lmasa belgi va misolga qarang. Belgilar orasida formal, informal, literary, old-fashioned, approving va disapproving ham uchraydi.
scenes.say: Stubborn, adjective, disapproving: determined not to change your opinion. A stubborn refusal. He is stubborn and never listens.
scenes.say_uz: Stubborn, sifat, salbiy ohang: fikrini o‘zgartirmaslikka qaror qilgan. O‘jar rad javobi. U o‘jar va hech qachon quloq solmaydi.

scenes.title: Tezaurus va tekshirish
scenes.say_native: Tezaurus sinonimlar ro‘yxatini beradi, lekin ular almashtirib bo‘ladigan so‘zlar emas, faqat nomzodlar. Siz uni uch qadamda tekshirasiz. Birinchi: o‘quvchi lug‘atida ta’rif va belgini o‘qing. Ikkinchi: misol gaplarga qarang, sizning gapingizga o‘xshaydimi? Uchinchi: qidiruvda tanlagan iborangizni qo‘shni ot bilan yozib ko‘ring, masalan “powerful computer”. Natija ko‘p chiqsa, ibora tabiiy.
scenes.say: A thesaurus gives candidates, not replacements. Check the definition and label, read the examples, then search your phrase with its neighbouring noun.
scenes.say_uz: Tezaurus nomzodlarni beradi, almashtirishni emas. Ta’rif va belgini tekshiring, misollarni o‘qing, so‘ngra iborani qo‘shni ot bilan qidiring.

scenes.title: Lug‘at belgilarini o‘qing
board: slender (approving): thin in an attractive way
nosy (informal, disapproving): too interested in others
scenes.say_native: Uchta qisqa lug‘at maqolasi. Birinchi savol: kimnidir maqtash uchun qaysi so‘zni ishlatasiz? Ikkinchi: qaysi so‘z norasmiy? Uchinchi: nima uchun gaunt so‘zini maqtovda ishlatmaysiz? Ekrandagi belgilarga va ta’riflarga qarang: approving ijobiy, disapproving salbiy, informal esa so‘zlashuv uslubini bildiradi. Javoblaringizni sabab bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Which word do you use to compliment someone? Which one is informal? Why would you not use gaunt as a compliment?
scenes.say_uz: Maqtash uchun qaysi so‘z? Qaysi biri norasmiy? Nega gaunt maqtov emas?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: slender, belgisi approving, ya’ni ijobiy. Ikkinchi: nosy, informal belgisi bor. Uchinchi: gaunt ta’rifida kasallik so‘zi bor, ya’ni ozg‘inlik yoqimsiz sababdan. Ko‘rdingizmi, bir qatorcha belgi va ta’rif sizni xatodan saqlaydi. Yangi so‘zni gapingizga qo‘yishdan oldin ikki soniya shu belgiga qarashni odat qiling.
scenes.say: Slender is approving. Nosy is informal. Gaunt links thinness to illness, so it is not a compliment.
scenes.say_uz: Slender ijobiy. Nosy norasmiy. Gaunt ozg‘inlikni kasallik bilan bog‘laydi, shuning uchun maqtov emas.

scenes.title: Tinglash: sarlavha tahriri
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Muharrir va muxbir yangilik sarlavhasi va maqolasini tahrir qilmoqda. Ular uchta so‘zni almashtiradi. Tinglang: qaysi so‘zlar, nima uchun almashtiriladi. Birinchi almashtirish ohangga tegishli, qolgan ikkitasi esa hamrohlikka. Sarlavhada bitta so‘z butun xabarning ma’nosini o‘zgartirib yuborishi mumkin, shuning uchun muharrirlar so‘z tanlashga juda e’tiborli. Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: I wrote: the famous businessman. Famous sounds like admiration. He is known for fraud, so notorious fits better. And a big number of investors lost money? Say a large number of investors. Last one: the quick growth of the firm? The usual phrase is rapid growth.
scenes.say_uz: Men yozdim: mashhur tadbirkor. Famous maqtov kabi eshitiladi. U firibgarlik bilan nom chiqargan, notorious mosroq. Ko‘p sonli investor pul yo‘qotdi-chi? A large number of investors deng. Oxirgisi: firmaning tez o‘sishi? Odatiy ibora rapid growth.

scenes.title: Tahrirni eslang
scenes.say_native: Uch savol. Birinchi: famous o‘rniga qaysi so‘z qo‘yildi va nega? Ikkinchi: a big number o‘rniga nima? Uchinchi: quick growth o‘rniga nima? Suhbatni eslang va to‘liq javob bering. Birinchi savolda sababni ham ayting: nega aynan shu so‘z mos keladi? Ikkinchi va uchinchida faqat almashtirilgan ibora yetarli. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: One: what replaced famous, and why? Two: what replaced a big number? Three: what replaced quick growth?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: famous o‘rniga nima va nega? Ikki: a big number o‘rniga nima? Uch: quick growth o‘rniga nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: notorious, chunki u firibgarlik bilan nom chiqargan, famous esa maqtov kabi eshitiladi. Ikkinchi: a large number of. Uchinchi: rapid growth. Ko‘rdingizmi, muharrir uchala marta ham to‘rt jihatdan bittasini tekshirdi: birinchida ohang, ikkinchi va uchinchisida hamrohlik. Siz ham tahrir qilganda shunday savollar bering.
scenes.say: Notorious, because he is known for fraud. A large number. Rapid growth. The editor checked connotation once and collocation twice.
scenes.say_uz: Notorious, chunki firibgarlik bilan mashhur. A large number. Rapid growth. Muharrir bir marta ohangni, ikki marta hamrohlikni tekshirdi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: farqni tushuntiring
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ikki juft so‘z orasidagi farqni inglizcha, bittadan gap bilan tushuntiring: cheap va inexpensive, childish va childlike. Ma’no, ohang yoki hamrohlikni ishlating. Ayting: “Inexpensive simply says…” va davom ettiring. Ko‘p o‘ylamang, to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Explain in one sentence each: cheap versus inexpensive, and childish versus childlike. Use meaning, connotation or collocation.
scenes.say_uz: Har birini bitta gap bilan tushuntiring: cheap va inexpensive, childish va childlike. Ma’no, ohang yoki hamrohlikdan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Inexpensive simply says the price is low; cheap can suggest poor quality.
Childlike praises innocence; childish criticises immature behaviour.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. Inexpensive faqat narx pastligini aytadi, cheap esa sifat past degan ma’noni ham berishi mumkin. Childlike bolalarcha soddalikni maqtaydi, childish esa pishmagan xatti-harakatni tanqid qiladi. Sizning javobingiz boshqa so‘zlar bilan bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin farq aniq bo‘lsa va misol gap bo‘lsa, javob to‘g‘ri. Uyga vazifada ana shu ishni olti juft bilan qilasiz.
scenes.say: Inexpensive simply says the price is low, while cheap can suggest poor quality. Childlike praises innocence, whereas childish criticises immature behaviour.
scenes.say_uz: Inexpensive faqat narx pastligini aytadi, cheap esa past sifatni ham bildirishi mumkin. Childlike soddalikni maqtaydi, childish esa pishmagan xatti-harakatni tanqid qiladi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Sinonim tanlashdan oldin to‘rt narsani tekshiring. Birinchi: ma’no va hamrohlik, large number, powerful engine. Ikkinchi: uslub, kids, children, offspring. Uchinchi: ohang, slim yoki skinny, thrifty yoki stingy. To‘rtinchi: grammatik qolip, persuade to, convince that. Tekshirish uchun o‘quvchi lug‘atidagi belgi va misollardan foydalaning. Tezaurus esa faqat nomzod beradi.
scenes.say: Check four things: meaning and partners, register, connotation and grammar. Then confirm in a learner's dictionary.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt narsani tekshiring: ma’no va hamrohlar, uslub, ohang va grammatika. So‘ngra o‘quvchi lug‘atida tasdiqlang.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Explain the difference in 6 synonym pairs
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. O‘zingiz tanlagan oltita sinonim juftligi orasidagi farqni inglizcha yozing. Masalan, bugungi juftliklardan yoki lug‘atdan topgan juftliklardan. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir juftlik uchun farqning turi aytilgan, ya’ni ma’no, uslub, hamrohlik yoki ohang, va har bir so‘zga bittadan misol gap bor. Lug‘atni tekshirishni unutmang. Keyingi darsda idiomalarni tabiiy ishlatishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, explain the difference in six synonym pairs. Name the type of difference and give one example sentence for each word.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: oltita sinonim juftligi orasidagi farqni tushuntiring. Farq turini ayting va har bir so‘zga misol gap yozing.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan 6 ta sinonim juftligi orasidagi farqni inglizcha tushuntiring. Mezon: har bir juftlik uchun farq turi (ma’no, uslub, hamrohlik yoki ohang) aytilgan va har bir so‘zga misol gap yozilgan.

quiz.why_uz: Son bilan large number ishlatiladi; big number g‘alati eshitiladi.

quiz.q: Which word describes a computer with great processing capacity?
quiz.why_uz: Texnika bilan powerful ishlatiladi, strong emas.

quiz.q: Which is most positive about a person's body?
quiz.why_uz: Slim ijobiy ohangda; skinny va gaunt salbiy.

quiz.q: A colleague never wastes money. You want to praise her. You say she is:
quiz.why_uz: Thrifty maqtov; stingy, cheap va mean tanqid.

quiz.q: Which word is the most formal?
'The studies ___ that the drug works, but they are small.'
quiz.why_uz: Kichik tadqiqotlar uchun ehtiyotkor fe’l suggest mos.
Persuade + obyekt + to-infinitiv; convince bilan that/of.

quiz.q: A man is known for fraud. Which adjective fits best?
quiz.why_uz: Notorious yomon ish bilan nom chiqargan degani.

quiz.q: Which has the stress on the first syllable?
What is the best first step with a new synonym from a thesaurus?
options: Check a learner's dictionary entry and examples
quiz.why_uz: Tezaurus nomzod beradi; ta’rif, belgi va misolni tekshirish kerak.
